meta.source: Areas: Govt of India DES Crop Statistics (district APY) avg 2018-19..2022-23; reliability and irrigation need: Field Shift engine replay 2001-2024 at the district's representative grid point.
caveats: irrigation_share is unknown (null): a high mismatch index means the district's crops depend on irrigation, not that they are failing; it flags where water supply is the critical risk.
Rice is not split by season in the APY data; all rice uses the long-duration (Samba/Thaladi/Pishanam) profile.
